<?php

/* Shared functions for credit control: customer credit status, the credit control history log, overdue item selection, over-limit tests and the reminder letter stages.

The credit status (normal, watch, on stop) of a customer is not stored separately. It is the existing hold reason of the customer - debtorsmaster.holdreason - and holdreasons.dissallowinvoices: 1 means on stop and 2 means on watch, anything else is normal. Order entry, counter sales, customer inquiries and statements already read it that way, so a change made here is seen everywhere.

Security tokens: 21 = credit control (put on or off stop and watch, change limits, reviews, reminder runs, charges, write-offs), 22 = credit control approval (Finance Director approves write-offs above the limit).
*/

define('CREDIT_STATUS_NORMAL', 0);
define('CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH', 1);
define('CREDIT_STATUS_STOP', 2);

/* salesorders.creditflag values */
define('ORDER_CREDIT_NONE', 0);
define('ORDER_CREDIT_HELD', 1); // over credit limit or customer on stop - not to be dispatched or invoiced until credit control releases it
define('ORDER_CREDIT_WATCH', 2); // taken for a customer on watch - for information, can be dispatched
define('ORDER_CREDIT_RELEASED', 3); // released by credit control

function CreditStatusText($Status) {
	switch ($Status) {
		case CREDIT_STATUS_STOP:
			return __('On stop');
		case CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH:
			return __('On watch');
		default:
			return __('Normal');
	}
}

/* true if the logged in user has the credit control token */
function UserIsCreditController() {
	return (isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']) and in_array(21, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']));
}

/* true if the logged in user may approve write-offs above the limit */
function UserIsCreditApprover() {
	return (isset($_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']) and in_array(22, $_SESSION['AllowedPageSecurityTokens']));
}

/* Sales reps (SalesmanLogin) see only their own customers, customer logins only themselves */
function UserCanSeeCustomerCredit($DebtorNo) {
	global $CustomerLogin;
	if (isset($CustomerLogin) and $CustomerLogin == 1) {
		return ($_SESSION['CustomerID'] == $DebtorNo);
	}
	if ($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT COUNT(*)
							FROM custbranch
							WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
								AND salesman = '" . DB_escape_string($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin']) . "'");
		$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
		return ($MyRow[0] > 0);
	}
	return true;
}

/* returns the SQL condition limiting debtorsmaster rows to the customers of the logged in sales rep, '' if there is no limit */
function SalesRepCustomerLimit($Rep = '') {
	if ($_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'] != '') {
		$Rep = $_SESSION['SalesmanLogin'];
	}
	if ($Rep != '') {
		return " AND debtorsmaster.debtorno IN (SELECT DISTINCT debtorno FROM custbranch WHERE salesman = '" . DB_escape_string($Rep) . "') ";
	}
	return '';
}

/* The credit status and key credit details of a customer, false if the customer does not exist */
function GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT debtorsmaster.debtorno,
								debtorsmaster.name,
								debtorsmaster.currcode,
								debtorsmaster.creditlimit,
								debtorsmaster.holdreason,
								debtorsmaster.nextreviewdate,
								debtorsmaster.exemptinterest,
								debtorsmaster.exemptfees,
								holdreasons.reasondescription,
								holdreasons.dissallowinvoices
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN holdreasons
							ON debtorsmaster.holdreason = holdreasons.reasoncode
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 1) {
		$MyRow['status'] = CREDIT_STATUS_STOP;
	} elseif ($MyRow['dissallowinvoices'] == 2) {
		$MyRow['status'] = CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH;
	} else {
		$MyRow['status'] = CREDIT_STATUS_NORMAL;
	}
	return $MyRow;
}

/* Appends to the credit control history of a customer. The history is never updated or deleted. */
function CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, $EventType, $Detail, $Amount = 0, $CurrCode = '', $TransType = 0, $TransNo = 0) {
	$SQL = "INSERT INTO creditcontrollog (debtorno,
										eventdate,
										userid,
										eventtype,
										detail,
										amount,
										currcode,
										transtype,
										transno)
							VALUES ('" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
									NOW(),
									'" . $_SESSION['UserID'] . "',
									'" . $EventType . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Detail) . "',
									'" . $Amount . "',
									'" . $CurrCode . "',
									'" . $TransType . "',
									'" . $TransNo . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('The credit control history could not be updated because'), '', true);
}

/* The date the next review of a customer falls due, a standard period from today (CreditReviewMonths, set by Finance) */
function CreditNextReviewDate($Months = 0) {
	if ($Months <= 0) {
		$Months = $_SESSION['CreditReviewMonths'];
	}
	if ($Months <= 0) {
		$Months = 12;
	}
	return date('Y-m-d', mktime(0, 0, 0, date('n') + $Months, date('j'), date('Y')));
}

/* Puts a customer on stop, on watch or back to normal by setting their hold reason, and records it in the history. $ReasonCode must be a holdreasons code whose dissallowinvoices matches the new status. Returns true if done. */
function SetCreditStatus($DebtorNo, $NewStatus, $ReasonCode, $Notes) {
	$Customer = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Customer === false) {
		return false;
	}
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT reasondescription, dissallowinvoices
						FROM holdreasons
						WHERE reasoncode = '" . (int) $ReasonCode . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return false;
	}
	$Reason = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if (($NewStatus == CREDIT_STATUS_STOP and $Reason['dissallowinvoices'] != 1)
		or ($NewStatus == CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH and $Reason['dissallowinvoices'] != 2)
		or ($NewStatus == CREDIT_STATUS_NORMAL and in_array($Reason['dissallowinvoices'], array(1, 2)))) {
		return false;
	}
	DB_query("UPDATE debtorsmaster
				SET holdreason = '" . (int) $ReasonCode . "'
				WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'", __('The credit status of the customer could not be updated because'), '', true);
	if ($NewStatus == CREDIT_STATUS_STOP) {
		$EventType = 'STOP';
	} elseif ($NewStatus == CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH) {
		$EventType = 'WATCH';
	} else {
		$EventType = 'NORMAL';
	}
	CreditControlLog($DebtorNo, $EventType, CreditStatusText($Customer['status']) . ' -> ' . CreditStatusText($NewStatus) . ' (' . $Reason['reasondescription'] . '): ' . $Notes);
	return true;
}

/* SQL expression for the number of days an item in debtortrans is past its due date. Needs debtortrans and paymentterms in the query. Same rule as the aged debtors report. */
function OverdueDaysSQL() {
	return "CASE WHEN paymentterms.daysbeforedue > 0
				THEN TO_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - TO_DAYS(debtortrans.trandate) - paymentterms.daysbeforedue
				ELSE TO_DAYS(CURRENT_DATE) - TO_DAYS(ADDDATE(LAST_DAY(debtortrans.trandate), paymentterms.dayinfollowingmonth))
			END";
}

/* The open invoices and charges of a customer that are overdue by at least $MinDays. $IncludeDisputed false leaves out invoices marked as disputed. Interest and fees are charged on invoices only, never on earlier charges. */
function GetOverdueItems($DebtorNo, $MinDays = 1, $IncludeDisputed = false, $Types = '10,60') {
	$SQL = "SELECT debtortrans.id,
					debtortrans.type,
					debtortrans.transno,
					debtortrans.trandate,
					debtortrans.balance,
					debtortrans.disputed,
					systypes.typename,
					" . OverdueDaysSQL() . " AS daysoverdue
			FROM debtortrans
			INNER JOIN systypes
				ON debtortrans.type = systypes.typeid
			INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
				ON debtortrans.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
			INNER JOIN paymentterms
				ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator
			WHERE debtortrans.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
				AND debtortrans.type IN (" . $Types . ")
				AND debtortrans.settled = 0
				AND debtortrans.balance > " . CurrencyTolerance($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['currencydefault']) . "
				" . ($IncludeDisputed ? '' : 'AND debtortrans.disputed = 0') . "
			HAVING daysoverdue >= " . (int) $MinDays . "
			ORDER BY debtortrans.trandate, debtortrans.id";
	$Result = DB_query($SQL, __('The overdue items of the customer could not be retrieved because'));
	$Items = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Items[] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Items;
}

/* The credit limit headroom a new order of $OrderValue (in the customer's currency) would leave: credit limit less the account balance, less the value of the other open orders. $ExistingOrderNo is left out of the open orders when an existing order is being changed. Negative means the order would take the customer over the limit. */
function CreditHeadroomForOrder($DebtorNo, $OrderValue, $ExistingOrderNo = 0) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT creditlimit FROM debtorsmaster WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Limit = $MyRow[0];
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance), 0) FROM debtortrans WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	$Balance = $MyRow[0];
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(salesorderdetails.unitprice *
								(salesorderdetails.quantity - salesorderdetails.qtyinvoiced) *
								(1 - salesorderdetails.discountpercent)), 0)
						FROM salesorders
						INNER JOIN salesorderdetails
							ON salesorders.orderno = salesorderdetails.orderno
						WHERE salesorders.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND salesorderdetails.completed = 0
							AND salesorders.quotation = 0
							AND salesorders.orderno <> '" . (int) $ExistingOrderNo . "'");
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return $Limit - $Balance - $MyRow[0] - $OrderValue;
}

/* What to do with an order about to be saved for a customer: returns array('refuse' => bool, 'flag' => salesorders.creditflag to set, 'message' => text for the user, 'type' => prnMsg type). Quotations are not orders and are never refused or held. Credit control themselves are not held by the over limit test. */
function CreditCheckForNewOrder($DebtorNo, $OrderValue, $ExistingOrderNo = 0, $Quotation = 0) {
	$Outcome = array('refuse' => false, 'flag' => ORDER_CREDIT_NONE, 'message' => '', 'type' => 'info');
	if ($Quotation == 1) {
		return $Outcome;
	}
	$Customer = GetCreditStatus($DebtorNo);
	if ($Customer === false) {
		return $Outcome;
	}
	$Contact = CreditControlContactText();
	if ($Customer['status'] == CREDIT_STATUS_STOP) {
		if ($ExistingOrderNo > 0) {
			/* changing an order taken before the stop is not a new order, but it cannot be dispatched until credit control releases it */
			$Outcome['flag'] = ORDER_CREDIT_HELD;
			$Outcome['type'] = 'warn';
			$Outcome['message'] = __('The account') . ' ' . $Customer['name'] . ' ' . __('is on stop') . ' (' . $Customer['reasondescription'] . '). ' . __('The order is held and cannot be dispatched or invoiced until credit control releases it') . '. ' . $Contact;
			return $Outcome;
		}
		$Outcome['refuse'] = true;
		$Outcome['type'] = 'error';
		$Outcome['message'] = __('The account') . ' ' . $Customer['name'] . ' ' . __('is on stop') . ' (' . $Customer['reasondescription'] . '). ' . __('No new orders can be accepted') . '. ' . $Contact;
		return $Outcome;
	}
	if ($_SESSION['CheckCreditLimits'] > 0 and !UserIsCreditController()
		and CreditHeadroomForOrder($DebtorNo, $OrderValue, $ExistingOrderNo) < 0) {
		$Outcome['flag'] = ORDER_CREDIT_HELD;
		$Outcome['type'] = 'warn';
		$Outcome['message'] = __('This order would take') . ' ' . $Customer['name'] . ' ' . __('over their credit limit') . '. ' . __('It has been accepted but is held for credit control approval and cannot be dispatched or invoiced until it is released') . '. ' . $Contact;
		return $Outcome;
	}
	if ($Customer['status'] == CREDIT_STATUS_WATCH) {
		$Outcome['flag'] = ORDER_CREDIT_WATCH;
		$Outcome['type'] = 'warn';
		$Outcome['message'] = __('The account') . ' ' . $Customer['name'] . ' ' . __('is on watch') . '. ' . __('The order has been accepted and is shown on the credit control list') . '. ' . $Contact;
	}
	return $Outcome;
}

/* Goods on an existing order cannot be dispatched or invoiced while the order is held for credit control, or while the customer is on stop unless credit control has released the order. Returns the reason, or '' if the order can go ahead. */
function OrderCreditBlock($OrderNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT salesorders.creditflag,
								salesorders.debtorno
						FROM salesorders
						WHERE salesorders.orderno = '" . (int) $OrderNo . "'");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return '';
	}
	$Order = DB_fetch_array($Result);
	if ($Order['creditflag'] == ORDER_CREDIT_HELD) {
		return __('This order is held for credit control approval and cannot be dispatched or invoiced until credit control releases it') . '. ' . CreditControlContactText();
	}
	if ($Order['creditflag'] != ORDER_CREDIT_RELEASED) {
		$Customer = GetCreditStatus($Order['debtorno']);
		if ($Customer !== false and $Customer['status'] == CREDIT_STATUS_STOP) {
			return __('The account') . ' ' . $Customer['name'] . ' ' . __('is on stop') . ' (' . $Customer['reasondescription'] . '). ' . __('Goods cannot be dispatched or invoiced unless credit control releases this order') . '. ' . CreditControlContactText();
		}
	}
	return '';
}

/* the text telling people who to contact about credit */
function CreditControlContactText() {
	$Email = $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['email'];
	if (isset($_SESSION['CreditControlEmail']) and $_SESSION['CreditControlEmail'] != '') {
		$Email = $_SESSION['CreditControlEmail'];
	}
	return __('Please contact credit control') . ($Email != '' ? ' (' . $Email . ')' : '') . '.';
}

/* The credit control stage letters. Returns array of stage => row, ordered by stage. */
function GetDunningStages() {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT stage, daysoverdue, subject, body FROM dunningstages ORDER BY stage");
	$Stages = array();
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_array($Result)) {
		$Stages[$MyRow['stage']] = $MyRow;
	}
	return $Stages;
}

/* The last reminder stage sent to a customer, 0 if none. Also returns the date it was sent through the second element. */
function LastReminderSent($DebtorNo) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT stage, sentdate
						FROM dunninghistory
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
						ORDER BY sentdate DESC, id DESC
						LIMIT 1");
	if (DB_num_rows($Result) == 0) {
		return array(0, '');
	}
	$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
	return array($MyRow[0], $MyRow[1]);
}

/* The e-mail addresses reminders for a customer go to: the contacts flagged to receive statements, else the e-mail of the customer's first branch */
function GetAccountsEmailAddresses($DebtorNo) {
	$Addresses = array();
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT email
						FROM custcontacts
						WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							AND statement = 1");
	while ($MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
		if (IsEmailAddress($MyRow[0])) {
			$Addresses[$MyRow[0]] = $MyRow[0];
		}
	}
	if (count($Addresses) == 0) {
		$Result = DB_query("SELECT email
							FROM custbranch
							WHERE debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
							ORDER BY branchcode
							LIMIT 1");
		if (DB_num_rows($Result) > 0) {
			$MyRow = DB_fetch_row($Result);
			if (IsEmailAddress($MyRow[0])) {
				$Addresses[$MyRow[0]] = $MyRow[0];
			}
		}
	}
	return $Addresses;
}

/* Fills a reminder letter's text from the stage definition */
function MergeDunningText($Text, $Customer, $Items, $Total) {
	$Lines = '';
	foreach ($Items as $Item) {
		$Lines .= $Item['typename'] . ' ' . $Item['transno'] . '  ' . ConvertSQLDate($Item['trandate']) . '  ' . locale_number_format($Item['balance'], $Customer['decimalplaces']) . ' ' . $Customer['currcode'] . '  (' . $Item['daysoverdue'] . ' ' . __('days overdue') . ")\n";
	}
	$Search = array('{customer}', '{company}', '{currency}', '{total}', '{invoices}');
	$Replace = array($Customer['name'],
					$_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['coyname'],
					$Customer['currcode'],
					locale_number_format($Total, $Customer['decimalplaces']),
					$Lines);
	return str_replace($Search, $Replace, $Text);
}

/* The customers a reminder run would write to, with the stage of letter for each. A customer is a candidate if they have an overdue item that is not disputed, at least as many days overdue as the first stage. The stage is the highest stage whose days have been reached, so a customer who has paid has no overdue item and gets nothing, whatever stage they were last sent. A customer who was sent the same or a higher stage less than CreditDunningMinDays days ago is left out, so nobody gets the same letter twice in a short time. */
function GetDunningCandidates() {
	$Stages = GetDunningStages();
	$Candidates = array();
	if (count($Stages) == 0) {
		return $Candidates;
	}
	$FirstStage = reset($Stages);
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT DISTINCT debtortrans.debtorno
						FROM debtortrans
						INNER JOIN debtorsmaster
							ON debtortrans.debtorno = debtorsmaster.debtorno
						INNER JOIN paymentterms
							ON debtorsmaster.paymentterms = paymentterms.termsindicator
						WHERE debtortrans.type IN (10, 60)
							AND debtortrans.settled = 0
							AND debtortrans.disputed = 0
							AND debtortrans.balance > " . CurrencyTolerance($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['currencydefault']) . "
							AND (" . OverdueDaysSQL() . ") >= " . (int) $FirstStage['daysoverdue'] . "
						ORDER BY debtortrans.debtorno");
	while ($DebtorRow = DB_fetch_row($Result)) {
		$Items = GetOverdueItems($DebtorRow[0], 1, false);
		if (count($Items) == 0) {
			continue;
		}
		$MaxDays = 0;
		$Total = 0;
		foreach ($Items as $Item) {
			$MaxDays = max($MaxDays, $Item['daysoverdue']);
			$Total += $Item['balance'];
		}
		$StageToSend = 0;
		foreach ($Stages as $Stage) {
			if ($MaxDays >= $Stage['daysoverdue']) {
				$StageToSend = $Stage['stage'];
			}
		}
		if ($StageToSend == 0) {
			continue;
		}
		list($LastStage, $LastDate) = LastReminderSent($DebtorRow[0]);
		$Skip = '';
		if ($LastStage >= $StageToSend and $LastDate != '') {
			$Result2 = DB_query("SELECT DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE, '" . substr($LastDate, 0, 10) . "')");
			$DaysSince = DB_fetch_row($Result2);
			if ($DaysSince[0] < $_SESSION['CreditDunningMinDays']) {
				$Skip = __('Stage') . ' ' . $LastStage . ' ' . __('was sent') . ' ' . $DaysSince[0] . ' ' . __('days ago');
			}
		}
		$Customer = GetCreditStatus($DebtorRow[0]);
		$Candidates[$DebtorRow[0]] = array('name' => $Customer['name'],
										'currcode' => $Customer['currcode'],
										'status' => $Customer['status'],
										'stage' => $StageToSend,
										'laststage' => $LastStage,
										'items' => $Items,
										'total' => $Total,
										'maxdays' => $MaxDays,
										'skip' => $Skip,
										'emails' => GetAccountsEmailAddresses($DebtorRow[0]));
	}
	return $Candidates;
}

/* Posts a customer transaction made by credit control - an interest or fee charge (type 60, positive), a charge waiver (type 61, negative) or a bad debt write-off (type 62, negative) - to the customer account and, when the debtors ledger is linked to the general ledger, to the GL: the trade debtors control account against $CounterAccount.
$Amount is in the customer's currency and signed. $HomeAmount is the same amount in the home currency at the rates it was booked at, signed (pass null to convert at $Rate). Call it inside a transaction. Returns array(transaction number, debtortrans id). */
function PostCreditControlTransaction($Type, $DebtorNo, $TransDate, $Amount, $Rate, $HomeAmount, $CounterAccount, $Reference, $Text) {
	$Decimals = $_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['decimalplaces'];
	if ($HomeAmount === null) {
		$HomeAmount = $Amount / $Rate;
	} elseif ($HomeAmount != 0) {
		$Rate = $Amount / $HomeAmount; // the blended rate of what was booked
	}
	$HomeAmount = round($HomeAmount, $Decimals);

	$Result = DB_query("SELECT custbranch.branchcode,
								custbranch.salesman,
								debtorsmaster.salestype
						FROM debtorsmaster
						INNER JOIN custbranch
							ON debtorsmaster.debtorno = custbranch.debtorno
						WHERE debtorsmaster.debtorno = '" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "'
						ORDER BY custbranch.branchcode
						LIMIT 1");
	$Branch = DB_fetch_array($Result);

	$TransNo = GetNextTransNo($Type);
	$PeriodNo = GetPeriod(date($_SESSION['DefaultDateFormat'], strtotime($TransDate)));

	$SQL = "INSERT INTO debtortrans (transno,
									type,
									debtorno,
									branchcode,
									trandate,
									inputdate,
									prd,
									reference,
									tpe,
									rate,
									ovamount,
									invtext,
									salesperson)
							VALUES ('" . $TransNo . "',
									'" . $Type . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($DebtorNo) . "',
									'" . $Branch['branchcode'] . "',
									'" . $TransDate . "',
									'" . date('Y-m-d H:i:s') . "',
									'" . $PeriodNo . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Reference) . "',
									'" . $Branch['salestype'] . "',
									'" . $Rate . "',
									'" . $Amount . "',
									'" . DB_escape_string($Text) . "',
									'" . $Branch['salesman'] . "')";
	DB_query($SQL, __('CRITICAL ERROR') . '! ' . __('NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE') . ': ' . __('The customer transaction could not be added because'), '', true);
	$TransID = DB_Last_Insert_ID('debtortrans', 'id');

	if ($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['gllink_debtors'] == 1 and $HomeAmount != 0) {
		$Narrative = mb_substr($DebtorNo . ' - ' . $Text, 0, 200);
		foreach (array($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['debtorsact'] => $HomeAmount, $CounterAccount => -$HomeAmount) as $Account => $GLAmount) {
			DB_query("INSERT INTO gltrans (type,
										typeno,
										trandate,
										periodno,
										account,
										narrative,
										amount)
								VALUES ('" . $Type . "',
										'" . $TransNo . "',
										'" . $TransDate . "',
										'" . $PeriodNo . "',
										'" . $Account . "',
										'" . DB_escape_string($Narrative) . "',
										'" . $GLAmount . "')", __('CRITICAL ERROR') . '! ' . __('NOTE DOWN THIS ERROR AND SEEK ASSISTANCE') . ': ' . __('The general ledger posting could not be added because'), '', true);
		}
		EnsureGLEntriesBalance($Type, $TransNo);
	}
	return array($TransNo, $TransID);
}

/* Allocates part of a credit transaction (a waiver or a write-off, debtortrans id $FromID) to an open debit item ($ToID). Same bookkeeping as the credit note and receipt allocation pages: a custallocns row, the debit item's alloc goes up and it is settled when nothing is left, the credit's alloc goes down (credits carry a negative alloc). */
function AllocateCreditControlTransaction($FromID, $ToID, $Amount, $AllocDate) {
	DB_query("INSERT INTO custallocns (amt, datealloc, transid_allocfrom, transid_allocto)
				VALUES ('" . $Amount . "', '" . $AllocDate . "', '" . $FromID . "', '" . $ToID . "')", __('The allocation could not be added because'), '', true);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans
				SET alloc = alloc + " . $Amount . "
				WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'", __('The allocation could not be applied because'), '', true);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans
				SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < " . CurrencyTolerance($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['currencydefault']) . ", 1, 0)
				WHERE id = '" . $ToID . "'", __('The allocation could not be applied because'), '', true);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans
				SET alloc = alloc - " . $Amount . "
				WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'", __('The allocation could not be applied because'), '', true);
	DB_query("UPDATE debtortrans
				SET settled = IF(ABS(balance) < " . CurrencyTolerance($_SESSION['CompanyRecord']['currencydefault']) . ", 1, 0)
				WHERE id = '" . $FromID . "'", __('The allocation could not be applied because'), '', true);
}

/* The currency decimal places and rate of a customer's currency */
function CustomerCurrencyDetails($CurrCode) {
	$Result = DB_query("SELECT decimalplaces, rate FROM currencies WHERE currabrev = '" . DB_escape_string($CurrCode) . "'");
	return DB_fetch_array($Result);
}
